content.short: Arcade lets users underwrite fixed-rate term loans using NFTs as collateral.
content.description: Arcade is an NFT lending platform that lets users underwrite fixed-rate term loans using NFTs as collateral. The platform relies on a smart-contract protocol, Arcade Protocol, to escrow high-value assets on the Ethereum blockchain. Its V2 release adds airdrop-friendly vaults and speeds up the process for both lenders and borrowers, enabling faster, more streamlined NFT-backed lending workflows on Ethereum.
